card.name: Just before a day-month date
card.fires_on: Small words like "on" or "hours", or a date separator, right before a day-first date such as "1 January 1937". Seen in history and web citation text.

modes.label: "on" before a date
modes.description: The word "on" directly before a day number and month name in narrative text.
modes.example: On 25 December 2004, Cassini released the European probe Huygens, which landed on Saturn’s moon Titan<< on>> 14 January 200

modes.label: Citation date start
modes.description: A separator or leading zero where a day-first date is about to be written in a citation or page footer.
modes.example: Sentence Fragments.” UIUC Center for Writing Studies. <<0>>2 Feb. 2005

card.writes: It lowers the odds of a month name coming next, since a day number is expected first.
card.plain: It fires where a day number is about to be written before the month, as in "on 14 January".
